description: Azure OpenAI LLM Judge for baseline predictions. Secrets only via env vars. GPT-6.1-sol Responses API: omit temperature/top_p/logprobs; use reasoning.effort=low.

rubric.CORRECT: Prediction gives a factually correct and sufficient answer to the question. It need not reproduce every gold detail. A more concise prediction is CORRECT when omitted details do not change the fact and the question does not require that finer grain (e.g. year-only when asked when; province when that answers where).
rubric.INCORRECT: Related but not equivalent: wrong entity/number/condition, incomplete set when the question needs all parts, coarser answer that changes meaning, or otherwise fails to uniquely/sufficiently answer the question.
rubric.UNCERTAIN: Cannot decide if the prediction is sufficient (e.g. parent organisation vs sub-body, broader era/category). Never count as correct. Do not use external knowledge to correct gold; judge factual compatibility of question + prediction + gold only.

rubric_notes: Judge whether prediction correctly and sufficiently answers the question, not whether it mirrors gold verbosity.
Omitting harmless detail allowed when question does not require that grain.
Omitting detail that changes entity, numeric value, or conditions -> INCORRECT.
